description: Newly established (2024) independent boutique investment management and advisory firm based in DIFC, founded by Meshal Alothman (CEO) and Raed Alnusf (CIO), granted a DFSA Category 3C licence in March 2024. Serves family offices, private clients, sovereigns and institutions across Outsourced CIO services, private & public markets, Sharia-compliant investing, wealth management, capital introduction and hedge funds. Alnusf previously restructured and grew Kuwait's Public Institution for Social Security (PIFSS) portfolio; the founders cite a track record managing a USD 150bn portfolio.

fit.reasoning: Fit 60/60: priority asset-manager segment (20) + UAE (15) + genuinely multi-asset (private & public markets, hedge funds, Sharia-compliant class — 10) + serves family offices/sovereigns/institutions as third-party money (10) + DFSA CAT3C regulated (5). Trigger 20/25: a brand-new DFSA licence (granted March 2024, ~2.5 years old, still effectively a new entrant with no incumbent system) is exactly the 'new licence granted, new entity' signal the ICP weights highest. Access 8/15: two named co-founders with public bios and a clear CEO/CIO split — a real, reachable decision-maker pair, no warm intro. Total 88 — work it now: a boutique multi-asset manager that set up its own operations from scratch in 2024 has no legacy system to migrate away from, which is the easiest kind of sale.
